data.description:
## Report

Multiple concurrent sessions simultaneously report `rebar review-plan` returning **INDETERMINATE** (unsigned, no determinate PASS/FAIL verdict). Sudden fleet-wide onset during a period of heavy concurrent multi-worktree activity (~70 worktrees; multiple sessions + a fanned-out batch of debug agents each running review-plan).

## Observed (descriptive; not yet root-caused)

- INDETERMINATE affects MULTIPLE independent sessions at once (systemic, not per-ticket).
- Local host resources are HEALTHY: load avg ~3.5, disk 28% used (1.3Ti free), no orphaned/leaked busy-loops (scripts/check_orphaned_load.py clean bar system daemons). So NOT local CPU/disk/leak exhaustion on this box.
- Provider config: rebar DEFAULTS TO AWS BEDROCK (`[llm] model = bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8`, acct 896586841071/us-east-1; rebar.toml ~L145-222). Config explicitly states the chain does NOT fail over on a credential error ('a credential error must not be masked by shopping for a provider whose key happens to work'). frontier class (review-plan) = opus on Bedrock; mixed-provider chains disable prompt caching.
- Tickets branch shows three-way divergence at report time (local cb530119, remote-tracking af98dfad, actual origin/tickets 4fbe6114) — heavy concurrent ticket writes from many sessions.

## Leads to test (for the investigator — do NOT confirm from source alone; these are dynamic)

1. **Bedrock account-level throttling** (ThrottlingException / 429 / TPM/RPM quota) from a burst of concurrent frontier/opus review-plan runs across sessions sharing ONE Bedrock account, mis-surfaced as INDETERMINATE with no failover. Likely SELF-INFLICTED by concurrent fan-out. Check the runner's exception classification (src/rebar/llm/runner.py, structured_run.py, review_kernel/verify.py+decide.py) for how a provider throttle/timeout/truncation degrades to INDETERMINATE.
2. **Stale-store gate refusal** — recent main commit 'Refuse gate certification on a stale store' (2598909d) + 'Fail closed on an unobtainable claim-gate basis' (1c0a202b). Under concurrent tickets-branch write contention the store could read stale for many sessions at once, refusing certification → INDETERMINATE. Check whether a stale-store refusal path returns INDETERMINATE.
3. Truncation/length collapse (structured_run.py:522 'finish_reason=length ... collapses to INDETERMINATE') under a degraded/throttled provider returning partial turns.

## Impact

Fleet-wide: no session can pass the plan-review claim gate → cannot claim tickets → work stalls across all sessions. Agents cannot --force (disallowed).

## Investigate WITHOUT adding Bedrock load

Do NOT reproduce by running live review-plan storms against Bedrock — that aggravates the incident. Reproduce the CLASSIFICATION path with an injected/mocked provider throttle/timeout/truncation and assert the resulting verdict, and inspect the stale-store refusal path locally.

Reported against origin/main at commit 55589c15 (current HEAD at report time).
data.title: review-plan returns INDETERMINATE fleet-wide under concurrent multi-session load
